title: February: Letting Go of the Future
coreMove: Aspirational clutter becomes harmful when it stops supporting present practice and starts using imagined futures to accuse the person living now of being unfinished.

exampleSpecs.audience: Bianca, a traveler learning to narrate a trip without purchases
exampleSpecs.stakes: A joyful trip could be misread as deprivation unless Bianca names what low spending made possible.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show travel points and New York City as evidence that connection can replace shopping as the travel reward.

exampleSpecs.audience: Lloyd, an adult child trying to speak plainly about family upheaval
exampleSpecs.stakes: A legal document has made a family rupture concrete, but everyone is tempted to keep acting normal.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the parents divorce, division of assets, and family home to show a future becoming concrete.

exampleSpecs.audience: Wilder, a reader separating practice from proof
exampleSpecs.stakes: Aspirational books can become evidence of inadequacy instead of invitations to read.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use classic novels and ideal self to distinguish present practice from self-judgment.

exampleSpecs.domain: adult sibling support during divorce logistics
exampleSpecs.audience: Stephane, a family member choosing one grounded act of care
exampleSpecs.stakes: The family story has changed, and silence can make each person feel alone inside the paperwork.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Turn division of assets paperwork into one caring present action.

exampleSpecs.audience: Lin, a project lead reframing low spending as access
exampleSpecs.stakes: A frugal trip could be sold as sacrifice instead of evidence that money can support richer experience.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show New York City and travel points as a concrete alternative to shopping-centered reward.

exampleSpecs.audience: Guillaume, a maker releasing proof objects
exampleSpecs.stakes: Unused supplies and formal clothes have become evidence that worth is postponed until a better self appears.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use little black dress, scrapbook materials, and ideal self to show objects accusing the current self.
